last_user_test_result.failure: The test checker lacked the stage description filter required by VerifyStage.title().
last_user_test_result.fix: Inherit the real Checker base, initialize it, and assert literal stage title and task data.

notes: Managed shell process groups require POSIX.
Command entrypoints for tool_invoke and messages_summary now submit owned operations.
Default application assembly remains scheduled for B09.

last_user_test_result.failure: Activity was probed before output polling, so file writes during that wait could be missed before the idle-timeout decision.
last_user_test_result.fix: Probe activity after output polling and timestamp progress after the probe; add a deterministic real-process regression covering cached file-activity marks.

notes: Check and Complete keep their domain implementations in vmanager.py.
Stage coordination is bound by OperationExecutor; the default application entrypoint switches in B09.
Control revisions are independent of validation revisions and persist with human review and flag overrides.
A model operation remains pending until its active MCP stage mutation actually completes.
McpServer, WebTerminalServer, MasterApiServer and MasterClient replace the Pdb-prefixed exports without aliases.
The existing frontend now delegates service ownership to ServiceManager; full RuntimeHost assembly remains B09.
Command HTTP routes remain for B06, but their listener lifecycle already uses the shared readiness/drain implementation.
Command-line backend configuration and pre-commands are prepared only after a real MCP endpoint is ready.
No pytest execution by the coding agent.

last_user_test_result.failure: Expected service state did not arrive. The test configuration omitted launch.default_args; registration saved the child before capability generation raised AttributeError, preventing a successful HTTP acknowledgement.
last_user_test_result.fix: Supply launch.default_args.use_zip_workspace from the current configuration contract. Assert HTTP registration success and capabilities, acknowledged registration, fresh heartbeats after restart, and independent disconnect with phase-specific timeout diagnostics.
